name: Yarin
description: The Yarin were a sentient species whose appearance resembled that of trees; their limbs were reminiscent of branches, while their skin had a wooden texture. The species was mobile but slow moving. In 24 ABY, a Yarin served as Harbormaster on the Dac resort known as Crystal Reef. He loaned his personal submersible to the Jedi Knight Cilghal and her companions from the Yavin 4 Jedi Praxeum.
